<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum lists the chemical shift values for each distinct carbon environment. Counting the unique shift values gives the number of chemically equivalent carbon types. The unique shifts are: 166.40, 144.78, 132.00, 130.07, 127.80, 52.24, 49.55, 43.55, and 19.23 – a total of 9.</thought>
<final_answer>9</final_answer>
